# raff_function (Resource)

Manages a Raff serverless function's configuration (runtime, memory, timeout, scaling). Code deploys happen outside Terraform — push with the `raff deploy` CLI, the dashboard, or a connected GitHub repo. Settings changes on a live function roll out as a new revision with zero downtime.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, unique within the account.
- `runtime` (String) Managed runtime (`python`, `node`, `go`) or `docker` for a Dockerfile build.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `extended_timeout` (Boolean) Allow timeouts up to 24h (long runs bill wall-clock memory; no extra fee).
- `max_scale` (Number) Maximum concurrent instances.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Instance memory. Memory is a paid meter (GB-seconds, wall-clock).
- `min_scale` (Number) 0 = scale to zero (idle bills nothing); >=1 keeps warm instances at 30% of the memory rate.
- `region` (String) Deployment region.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Request timeout. Up to 3600, or 86400 (24h) with extended_timeout.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `current_revision_number` (Number)
- `function_id` (String) Short reference id (fn-...).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug` (String) URL label — the name plus a short random suffix.
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint (automatic TLS).
